summary: Lloyds Banking Group plc filed a Form 6-K furnishing a Regulatory News Service announcement dated 12 October 2026, disclosing transactions by Persons Discharging Managerial Responsibilities under the Group's Share Incentive Plan. On 9 October 2026, executives including Chirantan Barua, Kate Cheetham, Sharon Doherty and Amanda Murphy acquired Partnership Shares at GBP1.006 and received Matching Shares at GBP0.00, executed outside a trading venue. No board recommendation, advisor, stake, premium or deal terms are stated. This is a routine PDMR shareholding notification mapped to a US Form 4 equivalent, with no special-situation or risk-arb angle.
